ops.oldText: Customer shall not develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.
ops.newText: Customer may develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept any restriction on the products or services we develop, buy or sell, so we have flipped the § 12.4 operator from "shall not" to "may", which also removes the contradiction with § 12.3. If Cobalt needs protection, we could discuss a narrow term-only restriction on a single named competing product, capped at 12 months with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions.
proposal.summary: Turn the § 12.4 competitive-activity prohibition into a permission so no non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds Customer.
